title: From a portfolio idea to a tested Jarvis workbench
summary: A public engineering record of the Jarvis portfolio milestone, assembled from its recorded GitHub commit and workflow. This entry supplies a starting point for documentary, publishing and educational adaptations. It does not describe private personal activities or claim a production deployment.

observations.text: The portfolio expansion added a local workbench with twelve authored initiatives, five-role mission planning and seven-channel editorial briefs.
The GitHub workflow for commit e645c64975dc05f3b0a0f9e06d7cc903d70031b0 passed 163 Python tests and 68 web-helper tests. Those checks cover authored code and offline fixtures.
A next development cycle should verify native browser behavior and complete one real reviewed AI-to-AI building task with an observable benefit.
